Sideboard.title: Sideboard
Sideboard.coinNote: The first time this pile is depleted in a game, the person who controls the most territories gains one Red Star token. (If there is a tie, nobody does.)
Sideboard.coinNoteShort: First time this pile is depleted: most territories gains one
Sideboard.even: Even: when this card is new in slot 1, an event occurs.
Sideboard.confirmComplete: {faction} completes the mission "{name}" and takes the reward. You can't draw a resource card on the same turn.
Sideboard.confirmSetup: Set up the sideboard for a new game? Every resource card goes back to its pile (hands, row and discard are emptied), the territory deck is shuffled and four cards are turned over into slots 1–4. A mission is revealed if there is a mission deck.
Sideboard.notBuilt: The decks haven't been built yet. A GM can build them from the window menu (or the campaign does it when it's created).
Sideboard.statusIdle: Waiting. Draw controls appear at the end of a turn for the player who may draw.
Sideboard.statusPrompt: Choose a card to draw: click a highlighted card, or use the dialog.
Sideboard.statusDraw: End of turn: you may take one highlighted card.
Sideboard.statusEligible: Eligible to draw a resource card at the end of this turn.

control.setup: Set up for a new game

log.upgrade: The {territory} territory card was upgraded to {n} resources.

chat.setupSub: {deck} in the draw pile · {coins} Coin cards
chat.setupText: Four territory cards are face up in slots 1–4. Laying them out does not trigger events.
chat.newSlot1Even: New in slot 1: {name} ({n}). Even: an event occurs!
chat.slot1Empty: Slot 1 stays empty: the draw pile and the discard pile are both exhausted.
chat.reshuffled: The draw pile ran out: the discard pile was shuffled into a new draw pile.
chat.coinPileTitle: The Coin card pile is depleted
chat.coinPileAward: {faction} controls the most territories ({n}) and gains one Red Star token.
chat.coinPileTie: There is a tie for the most territories: nobody gains the Red Star.
chat.eventSub: Perform the action on the card
chat.eventEmpty: The event deck has run out. The event discard pile is not reshuffled.
chat.eventBox: The card goes back in the box.
chat.eventDestroy: DESTROY this card: it leaves the game for good.
chat.eventDeck: The card is shuffled back into the event deck.
chat.eventPending: Where does this card go now?
chat.missionCompleted: {faction} completes the mission and takes {n} Red Star token(s).
chat.missionBoxed: The card goes back in the box.
chat.missionSticker: Its sticker goes in the faction card's red slot.
chat.scarsDealt: One Scar card was dealt to each of the {n} players.
chat.scarsNotEnough: Only {n} Scar card(s) for {players} players: nobody gets a Scar card this game.
chat.destroyText: Rip it up. Throw it in the trash. A small "x" goes next to the territory's name on the board.

CardsUI.turnUnavailable: Card trades go through the turn controller, which isn't available yet.

prompt.rule: If you control a territory shown on a face-up card, you must take one of those. Otherwise take a Coin card.
prompt.nothing: There is nothing you may draw: no face-up territory you control and no Coin card left.

hand.title: Resource cards
hand.starHint: At the start of your turn: any 4 resource cards buy one Red Star token.
hand.troopHint: When recruiting: turn in 2 to 10 resources for troops (no change given).

pick.ruleStars: Any {per} resource cards buy one Red Star token, whatever the coins on them. Territory cards go to the discard pile, Coin cards back to the coin pile.
pick.ruleTroops: Turn in cards worth 2 to 10 resources. You don't get change. Territory cards go to the discard pile, Coin cards back to the coin pile.
pick.needStars: {count} selected: choose cards in sets of {per}.
pick.needCoins: {coins} resources selected: you need at least 2.
pick.tooMany: {coins} resources selected: at most 10 can be turned in.

reason.noWar: there is no war being played
reason.noConquest: you must conquer at least one territory from an opponent to draw a resource card
reason.drewThisTurn: you already drew a resource card this turn
reason.missionCompletedThisTurn: you completed a mission this turn
reason.missionAlreadyCompleted: you can only complete one mission per turn
reason.mustTakeTerritory: you control a territory shown on a face-up card, so you must take that card
reason.coinPileEmpty: there are no Coin cards left
reason.maxValue: a territory card can have at most {max} resources
reason.noScarSpot: {territory} has no spot for a scar sticker
reason.falloutZone: {territory} is a Fallout Zone: it can't be marked in any way
